contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in AI, semiconductors, and enterprise software, but signal quality is uneven: PLTR has the strongest measured breadth yet is already extended, while MU, MSFT, and NVDA offer non-extended multi-channel alignment [gov_contract_accel] [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. With no completed track-record observations, conviction remains capped at medium [track_record].

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

Its factual partnership with Sam Altman adds ecosystem relevance [actor:Sam Altman]. Relative strength is elevated but remains below the pack's extension threshold.
